text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Fan Fest over, our usual training schedule resumes. One evening, I head back to the academy, driven by a sense of unease I can't quite place…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only to see Rudolf standing alone on the training track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears trickle down her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry that you had to see that. I should know that bitter tears are no good to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know now is the time to pick myself up and keep moving forwards. I know… and yet here I am, wallowing in self-pity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I do not deserve to call myself the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize instantly that she's talking about her poor performance at the Fan Fest.
choice_data_list: You were just tired, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's not it, Trainer. I am not judging myself merely by one race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This failure was the culmination of all of my deeds prior to this point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is why it stings so fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have pushed myself to forge furiously ahead in order to realize my vision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have not hesitated to unfairly impose my will on those around me if it would achieve my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I implored them to believe in the Emperor's strength. I assured them that I would lead them to bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And where did all of that lead me? To the shameful display you witnessed the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All the victories I have won so far will be worth nothing if I stop now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My dreams lie in the future, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And yet, I've come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All of my supposed majesty was exposed as falsehood under the bright light of day.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: What the heck was that? Isn't she supposed to be the Emperor?

text_block_list.name: Student Spectators
text_block_list.text: I've never seen the President run so slow… What happened?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I disappointed everybody who came to watch me race, yourself included.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, worse—I betrayed them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I was never qualified to be the Emperor in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks at me with anguish in her eyes. For the first time, I can feel she's genuinely relying on me and my judgment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thanks to the path we've walked together, I know exactly what to say.
choice_data_list: You don't have to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
choice_data_list: You're the Emperor, no question about it.
You're the Emperor, no question about it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But how can you say that? I appreciate that you are trying to encourage me, but twisting the truth isn't kindness.
choice_data_list: The proof is right in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right in front of me? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All this time, she's been laboring under a flawed understanding of what the Emperor needs to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true that the Emperor needs strength, but it's not the strength to carry everyone's burdens alone that she needs—it's the strength to attract and inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the course Symboli Rudolf has charted so far has proven beyond any doubt that she's capable of that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, the sound of countless footsteps reaches our ears.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Students
text_block_list.text: Preeeeez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What? But… why are you all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf lifts her head to see a crowd of Tracen Academy students running toward her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but notice that you were absent from the student council meeting today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I started asking around to see where you might be, and… well, it turns out that a great number of students wanted to help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. I'm sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If this is about role assignment, I can have the draft to you by—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That won't be necessary. I have taken care of it myself, more or less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian will chair the event.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I keep telling you, you should do it. I'm not much of a speaker.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We have already discussed this. I will have my hands full as general coordinator.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Both of those roles are usually mine. Why would you…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I see. You've given up on me after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You've concluded that following my lead will not guide you to bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. If my people do not want me, I shall yield the thro—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We are simply doing what we think is necessary, nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I cannot possibly allow you to stand on stage when you are still exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: After all, who else but the Emperor will inspire us to dream?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The dorm leaders will help pick up our slack.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You got it! We'll be directin' the crowds before and after the event!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I asked my dear ponies to pitch in too, and they all happily agreed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Anything for the President, they said! You should have seen how they fought over who got to do what!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please, there's no need to go to so much trouble…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trouble? Who said it was any trouble?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We all know you're out there busting your butt for us, President.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The whole class is psyched we finally get to return the favor. Whatever needs doing, we'll hop-hop right to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And if you need any heavy lifting done, just leave it to me and these guns! Look at 'em flex!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I… don't know what to say…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Has this reminded you yet, President?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We want to walk the path you walk—chase the dream you chase.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We don't just want to sit on our hands and wait for you to create a world of bliss. We want to seize it with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So please don't think of us as sheep to be protected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We're fully capable of running on our own two feet!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're right. I see now…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How could I have forgotten? Thoughtless barely begins to cover my behavior…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems I've gotten so used to relying only on myself, I forgot how to lend an ear to those around me.
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know.
choice_data_list: And in what you've accomplished so far.
And in what you've accomplished so far.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I know. I will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Thank you, one and all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's eyes begin to glisten once again. But this time, it's not tears that glimmer in her eyes, but the light of a firm will.
